scene: Aromatic blue vapor billows out, unveiling three busy transit lines leaving town.
picture: Along a flat street line, the player in lilac scarf and mustard coat stands left of centre by the open jar. On the far left sits a teal glass-roofed trolley. In the centre rises an ornate spiral lift cage with open gate. On the far right waits a red mountain cable tram.
shown: A teal glass-roofed trolley resting on tracks at the far left
A brass spiral lift cage with open gate standing in the centre
A red mountain cable tram moored to a platform on the far right
